responses.text: {"score":93,"summary":"The document declares its language, carries a descriptive title, offers a skip link and a main landmark, and its text colors sit well above 4.5:1, with the remaining issues being a duplicated h1 in the banner and the absence of header, navigation and footer landmarks.","issues":[{"ruleId":"heading-multiple","claimKind":"structure","issue":"The page contains two h1 elements, one inside the styled banner and a second one immediately after it with nearly the same wording, so the document announces two top-level titles.","wcag":"1.3.1","severity":"minor","count":1,"location":"Form 1040: U.S. Individual Income Tax Return for 1954"},{"ruleId":"region-landmarks","claimKind":"absence","issue":"Only a main landmark is present; there is no header, navigation or footer landmark, so the banner and the closing form-number line are not distinguishable as regions.","wcag":"1.3.1","severity":"moderate","count":1,"location":"document"}],"passes":["1. LANGUAGE: the html element declares lang=\"en\".","2. TITLE: the title element reads Accessible Document — irs-f1040-1954-scan, which identifies the document.","3. HEADINGS: an h1 exists; apart from the duplicate banner h1 noted above, the outline is sequential (h1 then h2 headings, with h3 used only under h2).","4. LANDMARKS: a main landmark with id main-content wraps the content (header/nav/footer noted above as missing).","5. IMAGES: this section contains no img elements, so no alt text is missing.","6. TABLES: no tables occur in this section.","7. CONTRAST: body text #1e293b and headings #0f172a/#111111 on #ffffff exceed 12:1; the figcaption color #64748b on white is about 4.8:1; the skip link when focused is white on #2563eb, about 5.2:1.","8. LINKS: the only link is the skip link, whose text Skip to main content describes its target.","9. LISTS: no bullet characters are used in place of list markup in this section.","10. SKIP NAV: a Skip to main content link is the first focusable element and targets #main-content.","11. FORMS: this section contains no form controls; the crop-adjustment script only builds labelled number inputs inside a dialog when it is opened."]}
